detail.longDescription: A genuine github.com device code page doesn't prove who started the sign-in. Microsoft's lab PoC: start a Copilot CLI device flow, phish the code, and with remote control on, steer the victim's agent session. https://www. microsoft.com/en-us/security/b log/2026/11/17/the-risks-of-device-code-authentication-for-ai-coding-agents/ Our terminal share links are credentials too. For watch-only: shell --read-only claude https:// shell.online # Cybersecurity # AIAgents # DevOps
